about: Hand decisions about MSL4 stat blocks that scripts/msh/roster.py applies after parsing (scripts/msh/gridbooks.py reads this book), and eleven text verdicts npcs.py applies. Every one was read off the page image (survey apps/marvel-heroes/docs/surveys/msl4.md, Stat blocks; decisions 7 and 9); none is a guess from OCR.

Every one of the book's 11 grids adds up (Health = F+A+S+E, Karma = R+I+P) and prints each code's standard number, so no block needs a misprint or an as_printed verdict (survey decision 7, plan row 32b, 2026-11-02).
Facts only - numbers, rank codes and a few words of a label - so this file is committed while roster.json stays in the local cache.
match     {page, header}: the printed page in the Adventure Book and the whole header as the card prints it
verdict   misprint    the book prints a value its own arithmetic contradicts; 'printed' keeps what the page says, 'corrected' what the rules give
as_printed  the book prints it that way on purpose
text        match {row}: an msh_book_text row key; 'read' a few words as the OCR gives them after folding to ASCII, 'printed' as the page prints them. It must occur once in the row, or npcs.py stops.
also      further values of the same block: one override matches one block
checked   the date the page image was read

overrides.note: Flight, printed 18 (PDF 20): the OCR read the capital I of It as a backslash; the trial's speck line for it is ten words, which the Marvel smoke suite's leak check refuses, so row 32a dropped it and the mark is mended in the row instead, as MSL3's Ice Bat's (row 32b). Read on a 400 dpi crop of PDF 20 (row 32b).

Matter Fluctuation, printed 31 (PDF 33), column 1: the first of two bulleted lines; the page prints a round bullet, which the OCR read as a letter e before a capital, and no reader rule strips it (MX1 bullet_marks needs a lower-case word after the mark). The same text in MSL2 (Stygorr, printed 31) carries the same two verdicts in msl2-overrides.json. Read on a 400 dpi crop of PDF 33 (plan marvel-11-books close-out, item b).
